scope: Joined FIXTURE funding owner/outbox first-pass snapshot; superseded only by a later explicitly hashed repair review

findings.description: The outbox and receipt tables have only UPDATE/DELETE refusal triggers. With SQLite recursive_triggers disabled, INSERT OR REPLACE at an existing primary key can replace the immutable observation/effects or publication receipt without firing the DELETE trigger.
findings.minimal_fix: Reject duplicate primary keys in BEFORE INSERT triggers; preserve exact writer/receipt replay by explicitly validating and returning an existing row before INSERT rather than relying on INSERT OR IGNORE.
findings.regression: Genuine owned pending/published rows; recursive_triggers=OFF; INSERT OR REPLACE with changed valid bytes must fail and preserve original rows in both tables.

findings.description: ProductFundingPublication.effects verifies effects_json/effects_hash but never observation_json/observation_hash or the retained source_material commitment. Pending recovery publishes batch.effects, so a damaged source observation can still become a canonical funding fact and a marked publication.
findings.minimal_fix: Before exposing effects for recovery or marking, validate bounded canonical observation bytes against observation_hash, expected observation profile and original entry/flat links, and compare the same captured normalized source material to the evidence source_material_hash.
findings.regression: After genuine canonical-publication failure leaves a pending outbox, corrupt retained observation/hash/source/entry-link in controlled fixtures. Recovery must deny before canonical publication/receipt, then exact restored rows must replay with no provider requests.
